verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents several bulk-style operations: running simulations in bulk batches across hundreds of scenarios with side-by-side comparisons, replaying historical tickets in bulk, auditing knowledge bases at scale via MCP, and Coach scoring 100% of conversations. These are tied to testing and QA, though, not general-purpose bulk actions on items. missing for 10: general bulk edit/update/delete actions across tickets, workflows or articles; documented batch APIs or limits; independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.
